code_block:
apiVersion: apps/v1

kind: Deployment

metadata:

  name: release-name-vulntracker

  labels:

    app.kubernetes.io/name: vulntracker

    app.kubernetes.io/instance: release-name

    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"

    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm

spec:

  replicas: 1

  # Recreate avoids two pods writing the same SQLite file during a rollout

  strategy:

    type: Recreate

  selector:

    matchLabels:

      app.kubernetes.io/name: vulntracker

      app.kubernetes.io/instance: release-name

  template:

    metadata:

      labels:

        app.kubernetes.io/name: vulntracker

        app.kubernetes.io/instance: release-name

    spec:

      serviceAccountName: release-name-vulntracker

      # The app never calls the Kubernetes API, so don't hand it a token

      automountServiceAccountToken: false

      # Don't inject env vars describing every other Service in the namespace

      enableServiceLinks: false

      securityContext:

        fsGroup: 10001

        runAsGroup: 10001

        runAsNonRoot: true

        runAsUser: 10001

        seccompProfile:

          type: RuntimeDefault

      containers:

        - name: api

          image: "ghcr.io/pavawsdev/vulntracker-api:1.0.0"

          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          ports:

            - name: http

              containerPort: 8000

              protocol: TCP

          env:

            # Non-secret config only; secrets are files under secretsMountPath

            - name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL

              value: "https://vulntracker.example.com"

            - name: NOTIFY_SERVICE_URL

              value: "http://vulntracker-notify:3001"

            - name: DATABASE_URL

              value: "sqlite:////data/vulntracker.db"

            # Path to the secret file, not the secret itself

            - name: JWT_SECRET_KEY_FILE

              value: "/var/run/secrets/vulntracker/jwt-secret-key"

          securityContext:

            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

            capabilities:

              drop:

              - ALL

            privileged: false

            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

          resources:

            limits:

              cpu: 500m

              memory: 256Mi

            requests:

              cpu: 100m

              memory: 128Mi

          readinessProbe:

            httpGet:

              path: /health

              port: http

            periodSeconds: 10

          livenessProbe:

            httpGet:

              path: /health

              port: http

            initialDelaySeconds: 10

            periodSeconds: 20

          volumeMounts:

            - name: data

              mountPath: /data

            # Writable scratch space, since the root filesystem is read-only

            - name: tmp

              mountPath: /tmp

            - name: secrets

              mountPath: /var/run/secrets/vulntracker

              readOnly: true

      volumes:

        - name: data

          emptyDir:

            sizeLimit: 1Gi

        - name: tmp

          emptyDir:

            sizeLimit: 64Mi

        - name: secrets

          secret:

            secretName: release-name-vulntracker-secrets

            # Read-only to owner and the pod fsGroup (the app user)

            defaultMode: 0440

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1

kind: Ingress

metadata:

  name: release-name-vulntracker

  labels:

    app.kubernetes.io/name: vulntracker

    app.kubernetes.io/instance: release-name

    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"

    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm

  annotations:

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps: "5"

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"

spec:

  ingressClassName: nginx

  tls:

    - hosts:

        - vulntracker.example.com

      secretName: vulntracker-tls

  rules:

    - host: vulntracker.example.com

      http:

        paths:

          - path: /

            pathType: Prefix

            backend:

              service:

                name: release-name-vulntracker

                port:

                  name: http
